description: The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow, its running estimate of real GDP before the BEA publishes it (annualized): the latest nowcast and each update since the first with the data releases behind it, what each part of spending adds and each part's own pace, the BEA's latest estimates beside it, and the model's record against the BEA's advance estimates. Read from the Atlanta Fed's workbook. A plain summary first. No key.

quarters.description: Quarters of the track record shown, latest first; default 8.

name: gdp_nowcast

outputSchema.description: updates is a table of each nowcast with the releases behind it; contributions_points and growth_pct are by part of spending at the latest update; track_record is the last nowcast before each advance estimate, latest first.

title: GDP nowcast (Atlanta Fed GDPNow)
